finds.quote: This manifesto names a disciplinary condition that the other documents in the family approach from particular angles. **Frontier experimental high-energy physics has, in its operational core, become a machine learning discipline while retaining the institutional authority of physics.** It has imported ML's methods without importing ML's disciplinary self-knowledge of what classifier systems can and cannot do, and it has retained physics's institutional standing without retaining the classical experimental practices that gave that standing its evidential force.
finds.note: Disciplinary-history thesis (authority without facility): frontier HEP became an ML discipline without importing ML's self-knowledge; argued in §4.2-4.4.

finds.quote: The discipline has not imported the disciplinary recognition that this is the architectural neighborhood in which model collapse becomes possible, nor the audit-protocol that would measure whether cross-generational phenomenal contraction has begun.
finds.note: Specific claim about what HEP has not imported from ML literature (OOD, model collapse, distillation, sim-to-real, Finke et al.); refutable from the published record.

finds.quote: - **Theory-first experimental design.** Experiments are now constrained by detector designs that were committed before the theoretical questions were sharpened; the question of which experiment to build is increasingly a question of which existing detector configuration can be retrofitted for the question at hand.
finds.note: Claims about what frontier HEP has historically shed (theory-first design, interpretable instruments, direct contact, training); W07's stylized time-allocation figures adopted as 'something real' at 246.

finds.quote: **Statement.** A completed meaning-event persists as history, but operative meaning continues only through renewed bearing: coupling to consequence, constraint, and corrigibility at successive points in the reception chain. Semantic systems that recursively consume their own outputs while losing such coupling tend toward prior-dominated convergence.

finds.quote: This is not an assumed identity with machine model collapse; it is a testable hypothesis whose form the archive can now specify. Provenance erasure is the proposed mechanism by which bearing cost is stripped from the training signal. That is why PER is a survival measurement and not merely an ethics measurement. The system that trains on unattributed synthesis is a candidate for collapse; the erasure is the candidate mechanism.
finds.note: Testable hypothesis: composition layer training on unattributed synthesis is a candidate for collapse, with provenance erasure as mechanism.
